newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Airline Tunis Air to distribute higher dividend.
newsitem.headline: Airline Tunis Air to distribute higher dividend.

text.p: Tunisian flag carrier Tunis Air will distribute a 2.79 dinar dividend per old share on its results for 1996, higher than 2.52 dinars per share for 1995 results, the company said on Thursday.
It will also distribute a 1.395 dinar per new share on its results for 1996.
It said payment will start on August 15.
The company on Wednesday announced that its post-tax net profits jumped by 76 percent to 26.57 million dinars from 15.1 million dinars.

Net operating profit was 9.736 million dinars, down from 30.4 million dinars. The company has allocated a 32.609 million dinars to reserves and 70.864 million dinars to the write off account. ($=1.095 dinar)
